One long room on West 7th, filled front to back

Simply 115 is an antique and vintage shop in downtown Junction City. Inside you'll find furniture with some history to it, dishes and glassware, jewelry, seasonal decor and handmade gifts, spread out under a pressed tin ceiling on worn wood floors.

The shop gets rearranged with the seasons, so there's always something you didn't see last time. Just moved in with Fort Riley, setting up a first apartment, or hunting for a gift? Come in and take your time.
